title: Engine response to operations golden_record and golden_replay (/io/response.json)
description: golden_record: the I/O of each case run on the base, hashed (golden.json). golden_replay: the same cases run on the candidate; diffs lists each case whose output differs from the recorded one, with both outputs. A diff is a behavior divergence unless a relaxation of pi_S applies. golden_replay reads the recorded golden record from /io/golden.json, which the core writes before the replay.

error.description: Set when a golden operation fails; reported in-band, like the error of the stub and signatures responses.
